items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,
Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die:
items.claim: Priests must not consume wine or strong drink when entering the tabernacle

items.quote: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
items.claim: The law shall remain in effect as a perpetual statute through all generations

items.quote: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
items.claim: A purpose of the law is to distinguish between holy and unholy, and between clean and unclean
items.object: difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean

items.quote: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
items.claim: A purpose of the law is to enable teaching of all God's statutes to Israel
items.object: all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them
